_comment: Every activity node sits inside a beat, and the result of each activity causes the next beat. That is the difference between a story and a themed list of drills: ask the animals and they SPEAK a clue; the count IS how many clues you hold; sorting them is what makes them point the way. The counts in n3 are authored (3 monkeys, 4 birds, 2 rabbits), which is why n5 can say 'nine' and mean it - a randomised count range would have made that line a lie on most runs.

lines.en: Noor's book came apart, and the Green Page blew into the jungle.
lines.ar: تَمَزَّقَ كِتَابُ نُور، وَطَارَتِ الصَّفْحَةُ الخَضْرَاءُ إِلَى الغَابَة.

lines.en: The jungle is big. But someone here saw where it went.
lines.ar: الغَابَةُ كَبِيرَة. لَكِنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ هُنَا رَأَى أَيْنَ ذَهَبَتْ.

lines.en: Ask the animals. Each one saw a little piece of it.
lines.ar: اِسْأَلِ الحَيَوَانَات. كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ رَأَى جُزْءًا صَغِيرًا.

lines.en: More animals were watching than you thought. Count each group.
lines.ar: كَانَتْ حَيَوَانَاتٌ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا ظَنَنْتَ تُرَاقِب. عُدَّ كُلَّ مَجْمُوعَة.

lines.en: Send each watcher back to its own place, so it can point the way.
lines.ar: أَعِدْ كُلَّ مُرَاقِبٍ إِلَى مَكَانِه، لِيَدُلَّكَ عَلَى الطَّرِيق.

lines.en: Nine watchers, and every one of them points the same way.
lines.ar: تِسْعَةُ مُرَاقِبِينَ، وَكُلُّهُمْ يُشِيرُونَ إِلَى الاِتِّجَاهِ نَفْسِه.

lines.en: Down, past the wide leaves. Noor says it must be very close.
lines.ar: إِلَى الأَسْفَل، خَلْفَ الأَوْرَاقِ العَرِيضَة. تَقُولُ نُور إِنَّهَا قَرِيبَةٌ جِدًّا.

lines.en: Down past the wide leaves, the watchers are all around. Look carefully.
lines.ar: تَحْتَ الأَوْرَاقِ العَرِيضَة، المُرَاقِبُونَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَان. اُنْظُرْ بِتَمَعُّن.

lines.en: You found it! The Green Page goes back into the book.
lines.ar: لَقَدْ وَجَدْتَهَا! تَعُودُ الصَّفْحَةُ الخَضْرَاءُ إِلَى الكِتَاب.

lines.en: The book feels heavier now. That is a good thing.
lines.ar: أَصْبَحَ الكِتَابُ أَثْقَلَ الآن. وَهَذَا شَيْءٌ جَمِيل.

lines.en: On the mended page there is a drawing: a busy market, full of colour.
lines.ar: عَلَى الصَّفْحَةِ المُرَمَّمَةِ رَسْم: سُوقٌ مُزْدَحِم، مَلِيءٌ بِالأَلْوَان.

lines.en: That is where the next page went.
